items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: And Wayne Wright sent me in as a sub.

ctx.x: Yes. They had a little quartet down there. And Wayne Wright sent me in as a sub. And I got along all right. But there was seven-eight time and things like that you know. And the keyboard player didn’t play piano, he played all kinds of, what the hell they call it. The drummer was never, never just rhythm, just me and the bass. I think Teddy Kotick was the bass player. So there was one in seven-eight time. Again I had the afterbeats. And it was one, zing, one, zing, one, zing zing. One, zing, one, zing— And so it…
It’s hard to be simple in seven-eight.
